# The Bridge Therapeutic Services

> Counseling and therapy in Tyler, Texas, with in-person services and telehealth counseling for eligible clients across Texas.

Use the linked pages for current practice information, services, therapist profiles, and appointment inquiries.

## Practice and appointments

- [Home](https://www.thebridgetherapy.com/): Practice overview and counseling services.
- [About The Bridge](https://www.thebridgetherapy.com/about/): Practice background and approach.
- [Our therapists](https://www.thebridgetherapy.com/therapists/): Counselor profiles and professional information.
- [Contact and appointments](https://www.thebridgetherapy.com/contact/): Contact details and how to get started.

## Selected services

- [Anxiety counseling](https://www.thebridgetherapy.com/anxiety-counseling-tyler/): Information about anxiety counseling.
- [EMDR therapy](https://www.thebridgetherapy.com/emdr-therapy-tyler/): Information about EMDR therapy.
- [Christian counseling](https://www.thebridgetherapy.com/christian-counseling-tyler/): Information about Christian counseling.
- [Online therapy in Texas](https://www.thebridgetherapy.com/online-therapy-texas/): Telehealth information, eligibility, and availability.
